FINDING (high, correctness): Advisory-only ActionItems are hidden behind the quiet state, so stale/missing optional states and their exact commands are not explicit or copyable. Evidence: `dashboard/lib/what-now-logic.js:191` routes any envelope without `needs_action` to `renderQuietStateHTML`; a direct render check for `reconcile:missing_snapshot` returned `false` for both title and command visibility. Recommendation: render ActionItem cards whenever `items.length > 0`; reserve quiet state for an empty item list, styling advisory/info bands restrained.

FINDING (medium, test_coverage): Tests lock in the incorrect advisory/info-only collapse behavior. Evidence: `dashboard/tests/unit/what-now-logic.test.js:283` and `dashboard/tests/integration/what-now-page.test.js:63` expect advisory/info-only envelopes to render no cards/commands. Recommendation: replace those assertions with coverage that advisory stale/missing items render non-alarming cards with visible/copyable commands.
